## About
Blue Dragon Plumbing is a family-owned plumbing business serving Austin and the surrounding areas, including Georgetown and San Marcos. Owner Gilbert Jimenez works on both residential and commercial properties, from a simple faucet installation to a water heater replacement.
We're rated 4.8 from 107 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to add you to our list of satisfied customers.
All of our work follows the Texas Plumbing Code, without exception. We are licensed, bonded and insured, and we're happy to answer any questions about our rates before we start.

## Services
- Water heater repair and installation: Repairs and replacements for home and commercial water heaters.
- Drain cleaning and repair: Clearing and fixing slow or clogged drains.
- Water leaks and water line breaks: Finding and repairing leaks and broken water lines.
- Kitchen and bathroom fixtures: Repair and replacement of kitchen and bathroom fixtures.
- Light kitchen and bathroom remodeling: Updating fixtures as part of a light kitchen or bathroom remodel.
- Insta-Hot and garbage disposal installation: Installing Insta-Hot units and garbage disposals.
- Appliance gas lines: Repair and replacement of gas lines to your appliances.
- Annual commercial gas line inspections: Yearly gas line inspections for commercial properties.
- Annual plumbing system maintenance: A yearly check of your plumbing system.

## FAQ
Q: What do you charge?
A: There is a one-hour minimum of $165, which includes travel time. After that, time is charged in 15-minute increments at $110 an hour.

Q: Do you charge to come out and look at a job?
A: There's no charge for surveys within the Austin city limits.

Q: Do you work on Saturdays?
A: Yes. We're available on Saturdays with no overtime charge. The only overtime charges are on holidays.

Q: Do you offer any discounts?
A: Yes. Our pricing includes discounts for senior citizens, military personnel and others. Give us a call to ask.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept checks, cash and all major credit cards.

Q: What should I do if I have a plumbing emergency?
A: Please call us at 512-947-2491 rather than sending an email.
